module: Table of the timer penalties applied at each vehicle recovery (reset) in rally. A recovery costs a fixed number of seconds, independent of the stage length. On a special stage: 5 s for a recovery, 0 s for a flip. Off a special stage (road section): 60 s and 10 s. Used by rallyManager:addRecoveryRaceTime.

specialStageSeconds.desc: Penalties on a special stage: recovery = 5, flip = 0 (the code path is kept but adds nothing).

nonSpecialStageSeconds.desc: Penalties off a special stage: recovery = 60, flip = 10.

getSpecialStageSeconds.desc: Returns the penalty in seconds for a recovery type on a special stage; 0 if the type is unknown.

getSeconds.desc: Returns the penalty in seconds depending on whether the stage is a special stage or not; 0 if the type is unknown.

isSpecialStage.desc: true for a special stage, false for a road section / other stage
